# config-hot-reload

> Hot-reload a configuration file in Go: content-hash change detection, parse and validate before swap, atomic reads, change callbacks and an injected tick source Go module `github.com/Trysac/u148-config-hot-reload`, package `confighotreload`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
